ucs.title: [LLM] Patchwork (Dropping Elephant / MONSOON) - Weaponized Office document spawns LOLBin child from user-writable path (BADNEWS / CVE-2017-11882 c
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical Patchwork delivery-to-execution chain: a spear-phished RTF/DOC opened in Word/Excel/PowerPoint (or the Equation Editor EQNEDT32.EXE abused via CVE-2017-11882, a Patchwork mainstay) spawning a scripting/LOLBin child that touches APPDATA/TEMP/PUBLIC. This is the exact stager pattern used by BADNEWS, NDiskMonitor and BackConfig loaders historically attributed to Patchwork by Kaspersky, Forcepoint (MONSOON), Volexity and Cisco Talos.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("WINWORD.EXE","EXCEL.EXE","POWERPNT.EXE","OUTLOOK.EXE","EQNEDT32.EXE") AND Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","hh.exe") AND (Processes.process LIKE "%\\AppData\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%\\Temp\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%\\ProgramData\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%\\Users\\Public\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%\\Downloads\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%.hta%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%.vbs%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%.vbe%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%.wsf%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%.sct%") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"(?i).*\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","eqnedt32.exe"]);
let SuspChildren  = dynamic(["mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","hh.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)
| where FileName in~ (SuspChildren)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Downloads\", ".hta", ".vbs", ".vbe", ".jse", ".js", ".sct", ".wsf")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","eqnedt32.exe"]);
let SuspChildren  = dynamic(["mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","hh.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in (OfficeParents)
| where ChildName in (SuspChildren)
| where CommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Downloads\", ".hta", ".vbs", ".vbe", ".jse", ".js", ".sct", ".wsf")
| where Account !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Patchwork - Office Document Spawning LOLBin Child Process from User-Writable Path
id: 7d3a9c1e-04b1-4d61-9c2a-pa7chw0rk0001
status: experimental
description: Detects Office or Equation Editor (CVE-2017-11882) processes spawning LOLBin children referencing user-writable directories or script extensions - the canonical Patchwork (Dropping Elephant / MONSOON / BADNEWS) delivery chain.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1203/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.t1218
  - attack.g0040
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\eqnedt32.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\hh.exe'
  selection_context:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '.hta'
      - '.vbs'
      - '.vbe'
      - '.jse'
      - '.sct'
      - '.wsf'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_context
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate macro-enabled enterprise templates dropping helper scripts (rare; whitelist by signing chain)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\eqnedt32.exe OR *\\EQNEDT32.EXE) @Image:(*\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\PWSH.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CERTUTIL.EXE OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\BITSADMIN.EXE OR *\\hh.exe OR *\\HH.EXE) @CommandLine:(*AppData* OR *appdata* OR *Temp* OR *temp* OR *ProgramData* OR *programdata* OR *Public* OR *public* OR *Downloads* OR *downloads* OR *.hta* OR *.HTA* OR *.vbs* OR *.VBS* OR *.vbe* OR *.wsf* OR *.sct*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|eqnedt32)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|powershell|pwsh|cmd|certutil|bitsadmin|hh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(\\\\(AppData|Temp|ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|Downloads)\\\\|\\.(hta|vbs|vbe|jse|js|sct|wsf)\\b)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Patchwork's documented operating procedure since at least 2015 has been spear-phishing on Indian foreign-policy / China-Pakistan / Tibetan / Bhutanese themes, delivering RTF and DOCX weaponized with CVE-2017-11882 (Equation Editor) or template-injection that drops BADNEWS/NDiskMonitor/BackConfig stagers. The unique telemetry signature is EQNEDT32.EXE (or Word/Excel) as the parent of a script/LOLBi
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.title: [LLM] Patchwork (Quilted Tiger / Hangover) - LOLBin contacting dead-drop resolver web services (BADNEWS C2 staging)
ucs.description: Hunts T1102.001 dead-drop resolver C2 - the specific BADNEWS technique of fetching its real C2 address from a comment field on Pastebin, Blogspot/Blogger, GitHub Gist, Tumblr or RSS aggregators. The detection flags non-browser scripting binaries (PowerShell, wscript, mshta, rundll32 etc.) reaching out to those public services, which is essentially never legitimate on a workstation endpoint and is a documented Patchwork tradecraft fingerprint.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","hh.exe") AND (Processes.process LIKE "%pastebin.com%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%paste.ee%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%ghostbin%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%hastebin%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%blogspot.com%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%blogspot.in%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%blogger.com%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%gist.github.com%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%raw.githubusercontent.com%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%tumblr.com%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%feedburner.com%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%wordpress.com%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%feedburner.google.com%") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"(?i).*\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let DeadDropHosts = dynamic([
    "pastebin.com","paste.ee","ghostbin.co","hastebin.com",
    "blogspot.com","blogspot.in","blogger.com",
    "gist.github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com",
    "tumblr.com","feedburner.com","feedburner.google.com",
    "wordpress.com"
]);
let LegitBrowsers = dynamic([
    "chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe",
    "iexplore.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe",
    "slack.exe","teams.exe","msteams.exe","onedrive.exe","outlook.exe"
]);
let LolBins = dynamic([
    "powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe",
    "mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe",
    "certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","hh.exe"
]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (DeadDropHosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (LegitBrowsers)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LolBins)
   or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
          InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let DeadDropHosts = dynamic([
    "pastebin.com","paste.ee","ghostbin.co","hastebin.com",
    "blogspot.com","blogspot.in","blogger.com",
    "gist.github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com",
    "tumblr.com","feedburner.com","feedburner.google.com",
    "wordpress.com"
]);
let LolBins = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","hh.exe"]);
let ProcessSide = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ChildName in (LolBins)
    | where CommandLine has_any (DeadDropHosts)
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, MatchType = "4688_cmdline";
let DnsSide = ImDnsActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DnsQuery has_any (DeadDropHosts)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer = DvcHostname, Account = SrcUsername, ParentProcessName = "", NewProcessName = "", CommandLine = DnsQuery, MatchType = "dns_query";
union isfuzzy=true ProcessSide, DnsSide
| order by TimeGenerated desc

description: Detects non-browser scripting/LOLBin processes referencing public web services (Pastebin, Blogspot, GitHub gist, Tumblr, Feedburner, WordPress) in their command line - the dead-drop resolver pattern used by Patchwork's BADNEWS / NDiskMonitor implants to fetch live C2 addresses (T1102.001).
references:

  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1102/001/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:

  - attack.t1071.001

logsource:

detection:

    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'

      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\hh.exe'
  selection_url:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'pastebin.com'

      - 'blogspot.in'
      - 'blogger.com'

ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\PWSH.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CERTUTIL.EXE OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\BITSADMIN.EXE OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\CURL.EXE OR *\\hh.exe OR *\\HH.EXE) @CommandLine:(*pastebin.com* OR *paste.ee* OR *ghostbin* OR *hastebin* OR *blogspot.com* OR *blogspot.in* OR *blogger.com* OR *gist.github.com* OR *raw.githubusercontent.com* OR *tumblr.com* OR *feedburner.com* OR *wordpress.com*)

| ContextImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|certutil|bitsadmin|curl|hh)\.exe$/i

| Hits >= 1

The fingerprint - a scripting LO
